# Six-disease run: cost estimate (2026-10-20)

*Generated by `analysis/cost/six_disease_estimate.py`. Session list-price readings, not billing figures. Tokens are characters / 4 throughout, so the divisor cancels out of the dollar figures.*

## Rates from the pilot (dollars per million input tokens)

| Source | Papers | $ | $/M tokens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke run, extraction v6 + gatekeeper v4 (central) | 20 | 53.50 | 237.13 |
| D-29 subset, extraction v5 + gatekeeper v3 (upper bound) | 20 | 58.92 | 261.16 |
| Run-2, extraction only | 85 | 165.80 | 166.73 |

Extraction is 70% of the central rate and the gatekeeper the rest (run-2's rate against the smoke run's).
